components.name: brow-button
components.description: A button component that can also handle links.

components.name: brow-card
components.description: Container used for segmenting general content into a visible block.

components.name: brow-layout
components.description: A composable layout with header, footer, left, right panels and content slots.

components.name: brow-section
components.description: A section used with `brow-layout` providing spacing around content and optional background.

components.name: brow-table
components.description: A data table that renders rows from child elements with support for templates.

components.name: brow-table-header
components.description: Defines column headers for a table using data-* attributes.

components.name: brow-table-row
components.description: A data row for a table using data-* attributes for field values.

components.name: brow-table-column
components.description: Defines custom rendering for a table column with template support.

components.name: brow-table-footer
components.description: A footer row for a table, typically used for totals or summaries.

components.name: brow-table-empty
components.description: Empty state content displayed when a table has no rows.

components.name: brow-table-sort
components.description: Plugin that enables sortable columns with click-to-sort headers.

components.name: brow-table-select
components.description: Plugin that enables row selection with checkboxes.

components.name: brow-table-paginate
components.description: Plugin that enables client-side pagination with navigation controls.

components.name: brow-table-tree
components.description: Plugin that enables hierarchical rows with expand/collapse functionality.

components.name: brow-tooltip
components.description: Tooltip that shows text hints on hover or focus.

components.name: brow-hovercard
components.description: Rich content preview that appears on hover.

components.name: brow-menu
components.description: Dropdown menu with items and keyboard navigation.

components.name: brow-menu-item
components.description: A selectable item within a brow-menu.

components.name: brow-select
components.description: Custom select dropdown with keyboard navigation.

components.name: brow-option
components.description: An option for use within brow-select.

components.name: brow-option-group
components.description: A group of options within brow-select.
